Author: Rakesh Thapliyal
Bench: Rakesh Thapliyal
 Office Notes, reports,
 orders or proceedings
Sl.
 Date or directions and Court'S Or Judges'S Order

S No  Registrar's order with  Signatures  C482 No. 1086 of 2024  Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1.
Mr. Dharmendra Barthwal, learned counsel for the applicant and Mr. G.S. Sandhu, learned Additional Government Advocate assisted by Mr. Akshay Latwal, learned Brief Holder for the State.

2. By the instant C482 Application, the applicant is praying for direction to expedite the trial of Criminal Case No. 424 of 2015 (Case Crime No. 122 of 2013), State Vs. Bhagwati Prasad and others,
for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 & 120-B of IPC, Police Station - Patel Nagar, District - Dehradun, which is pending in the Court of Ist Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun since 2015.

entities.text: State Vs. Bhagwati Prasad and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Police Station - Patel Nagar, District - Dehradun
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Court of Ist Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. It appears from the order sheet of the trial Court that the accused, against whom the trial is going on, they are adopting delaying tactics.
4. Mr. G.S. Sandhu, learned Additional Government Advocate has no objection to the prayer as sought for by the applicant, as the trial is pending for the last more than 9 years.

5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the Trial Court is directed to expedite the trial of Criminal Case No. 424 of 2015 (Case Crime No. 122 of 2013), State Vs. Bhagwati Prasad and others for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 & 120-B of IPC, Police Station - Patel Nagar, District - Dehradun as expeditiously as possible preferably within a period of six months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
